summary: Iteration 2 — responsive + admin dashboard verification. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (added test_stats_recent_and_upcoming_populate which confirms /api/stats returns `recent` and `upcoming_follow_ups` arrays and that setting a follow_up_date on a lead makes it appear in upcoming_follow_ups). Frontend: all 7 public pages (/, /services, /services/erp-development, /industries, /work, /about, /contact) have zero horizontal overflow at mobile (390x844), tablet (768x1024) and desktop (1920x1080). Mobile menu (mobile-menu-button) opens a sheet with testids mobile-nav-services-link / mobile-nav-industries-link / mobile-nav-work-link / mobile-nav-about-link / mobile-nav-contact-link / mobile-get-quote-button — all navigate correctly. 4-step lead form on mobile (lead-form-step-1-*-input → lead-form-type-* → lead-form-budget-* + lead-form-timeline-* → lead-form-description-input + lead-form-submit-button) completes and redirects to /thank-you. Admin mobile: no horizontal overflow, desktop tabs hidden, admin-mobile-tab-overview/leads/settings bottom bar visible and all three tabs switch correctly, leads render as lead-card-<id> with lead-card-status-select-<id>, tapping a card opens lead-detail-sheet. Admin desktop: admin-tab-overview/leads/settings all work, admin-lead-table visible on Leads tab, Overview shows new overview-recent-leads and overview-upcoming-followups cards populated with real data; setting lead-detail-followup-input date on a lead causes it to immediately appear in overview-upcoming-followups (verified end-to-end). Brute-force counter was retested and lockout now hits within tolerance (atomic $inc fix from prior iteration is holding).

issues: Follow-up date field (lead-detail-followup-input) uses the browser's native <input type="date"> picker instead of a shadcn Calendar / popover component. Functionally works and auto-saves on change, but is inconsistent with the rest of the UI which uses shadcn components. Low priority UX polish item.

action_items: (Optional UX polish) Replace native <input type=date> for lead-detail-followup-input with a shadcn Calendar/Popover for visual consistency with the rest of the admin UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Responsive implementation is clean: desktop tabs correctly hide via Tailwind md:flex utilities, mobile bottom tab bar correctly shows via md:hidden, no element clips at 390/768/1920 viewports across all public and admin pages.

/api/stats endpoint cleanly derives `recent` (last 5 by created_at desc) and `upcoming_follow_ups` (max 6, future dates only, excludes Won/Lost) with ObjectId converted to str via brief() — no _id leakage.
Overview cards (overview-recent-leads, overview-upcoming-followups) read directly from /api/stats so there is a single source of truth; no duplicated client-side filtering logic.
